description: Create a PUBLIC link to a bot's live chart (https://www.tradestaq.com/chart/...) that anyone with the link can open, no account needed. It shows the bot's open positions and its trades by default; PnL and balance only when you turn them on. This publishes the bot's trading: confirm with the user what the link will show, and for how long, before calling. Check list_bot_share_links first to reuse a link. Needs write access to the bot's account (mcp:live for a live account). Limited to 10 links an hour. Revoke with revoke_bot_share_link.

expiresIn.description: How long the link works: "1h", "24h", "7d", "30d" or "never".

showBalance.description: Show the account balance. Defaults to false; leave it off unless the user asks.

showPnL.description: Show profit and loss. Defaults to false.

showPositions.description: Show the bot's open positions. Defaults to true.

showTrades.description: Show the bot's trades on the chart. Defaults to true.

name: create_bot_share_link
